metadata.description: Skills distilled from 32 screenwriting / television / dramaturgy books plus 12 volumes of published scripts and plays (Chekhov, Ozu, Succession, The West Wing, The Sopranos, Downton Abbey, Fleabag and more), covering features, TV series and the stage

plugins.name: screenwriting
plugins.description: 20 skills in four layers: general dramaturgy (workflow & story bible, structure, premise & theme, character & conflict, dialogue, scene craft, format & adaptation); the series layer (episode & season structure, series engine & bible, writers' room, half-hour comedy); tradition & trade (American case studies, Japanese, Korean & French, mainland-Chinese series practice, industry & business); and master corpora (Chekhov dramaturgy, Ozu screenplay style, Succession ensemble writing, television case studies)

plugins.name: screenwriting-en
plugins.description: English edition: the same skills as screenwriting, with English skill bodies translated from the Chinese files, for users who want to read and audit the instructions the agent runs
